title: This might be a stretch, but does anyone who was labeled an indigo child also have those repeating ‘mall world’ type dreams?
content: Growing up, my family used to call me an “indigo child,” and there were a few unexplained or weird experiences they still talk about. Now I sometimes have recurring dream environments that feel familiar (like mall-type places, casinos, airports). I’m wondering if this is something other people have noticed too, or if there’s a psychological explanation. Edit: this term was given to me in the early 2000s by my Evangelical grandmother, idk why the narc term is being brought into this lmao
